_doc: content_kind.py: one person or two people on the recording (ADR-0032). samples = frames spread over the whole recording; min_face = a face counts at this share of the frame height or more (a poster, a screen, a person far behind is smaller); share = the part of the frames with 1 face (solo) or 2+ faces (talk) needed for a clear answer. Not clear = solo rules with a WARN line (set "podcast" in the plan by hand). Checked on 2026-11-22: podcast Dworak 24/24 frames with 2 faces.
